mapper.select:
select finprodId, finprodAbbr, profitTypeCode, profitType, ccyCode, ccy, settleDate, netRedemptionShare, netRedemptionAmt, divIntAmt, reShare, shareLastDay, shareRemainderDay, pFinprodId, hasChildren,
cpriceDate, unitCprice
from ( select cp.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, cp.FINPROD_ABBR as finprodAbbr, cp.profit_type as profitTypeCode, cp.profit_type as profitType, d.CCY as ccyCode, d.CCY as ccy, DATE_FORMAT(d.settle_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as settleDate, SUM(CASE WHEN instr('C1,T18', d.ps) > 0 THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0) WHEN instr('C3', d.ps) > 0 THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0) WHEN instr('C2,T04,T05', d.ps) > 0 THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0) WHEN instr('C4,T06,T19,T24', d.ps) > 0 THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0) * -1 WHEN instr('C6', d.ps) > 0 THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0) * -1 WHEN instr('C5,T07', d.ps) > 0 THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0) * -1 WHEN instr('', d.ps) > 0 THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0) * -1 ELSE 0 END) as netRedemptionShare,
SUM(CASE WHEN instr('C1,T18', d.ps) > 0 THEN IFNULL(d.TRADE_AMT - IFNULL(D.FEE_AMT_PAY,0), 0) WHEN instr('C3', d.ps) > 0 THEN IFNULL(d.TRADE_AMT - IFNULL(D.FEE_AMT_PAY,0), 0) WHEN instr('C2,T04,T05', d.ps) > 0 THEN IFNULL(d.TRADE_AMT - IFNULL(D.FEE_AMT_PAY,0), 0) WHEN instr('C4,T06,T19,T24', d.ps) > 0 THEN IFNULL(d.TRADE_AMT - IFNULL(D.FEE_AMT_PAY,0), 0) * -1 WHEN instr('C6', d.ps) > 0 THEN IFNULL(d.TRADE_AMT - IFNULL(D.FEE_AMT_PAY,0), 0) * -1 WHEN instr('C5,T07', d.ps) > 0 THEN IFNULL(d.TRADE_AMT - IFNULL(D.FEE_AMT_PAY,0), 0) * -1 WHEN instr('', d.ps) > 0 THEN IFNULL(d.TRADE_AMT - IFNULL(D.FEE_AMT_PAY,0), 0) * -1 ELSE 0 END) as netRedemptionAmt,
IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN (instr('01,03', cp.profit_type) > 0 and instr('T11,T12', d.ps) > 0) THEN IFNULL(d.INT_AMT, 0) WHEN (instr('02', cp.profit_type) > 0 and instr('C7,T09,T22', d.ps) > 0) THEN IFNULL(d.INT_AMT, 0) ELSE 0 END ),0) as divIntAmt, SUM(CASE
WHEN (instr('01,03', cp.profit_type) > 0 and instr('C10', d.ps) > 0) THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0) ELSE 0 END) as reShare, 0 as shareLastDay, 0 as shareRemainderDay, IFNULL(cp.p_finprod_id,'0') as pFinprodId, (case when count(scp.p_finprod_id) > 0 then '01' else '02' end) as hasChildren,
MAX((case when (cp.profit_type='01') then DATE_FORMAT(d.CPRICE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') else null end ))as cpriceDate, MAX((case when (cp.profit_type='01') then d.UNIT_CPRICE else null end ))as unitCprice
from FIN_PRODUCT cp left join FIN_PRODUCT scp on scp.p_finprod_id = cp.finprod_id inner join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL d on ( cp.finprod_id = d.finprod_id or scp.finprod_id = d.finprod_id ) where 1=1 and d.busi_type in('17','21','27') and d.SETTLE_DATE is not null and d.trade_status in ('01','02') and (d.f_trade_id not in (select t.f_trade_id from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t where t.trade_status = '03'
and t.busi_type in('17','21','27') and t.f_trade_id is not null
) or d.f_trade_id is null )
AND ( cp.finprod_abbr like concat_ws('','%',#{search},'%') OR cp.finprod_id like concat_ws('','%',#{search},'%') )
AND cp.finprod_id in
#{item}
and d.SETTLE_DATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{settleDateBegin},'%Y-%m-%d')
and d.SETTLE_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{settleDateEnd},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND cp.ccy IN
#{item}
AND cp.profit_type in
#{item}
AND cp.issue_Type in
#{item}
AND cp.P_FINPROD_ID IS NULL
AND cp.P_FINPROD_ID IS NOT NULL
group by cp.FINPROD_ID, cp.FINPROD_ABBR, cp.profit_type, cp.profit_type, d.CCY, d.CCY, d.SETTLE_DATE, cp.p_finprod_id
order by d.SETTLE_DATE desc )

select SUM(IFNULL(CASE WHEN (instr('C1,T18', d.ps) > 0 ) THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0) WHEN (instr('C3', d.ps) > 0 and cp.vdate != d.settle_date) THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0)
WHEN (instr('C2,C10,T04,T05', d.ps) > 0 ) THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0) WHEN (instr('C4,T06,T19,T24', d.ps) > 0 and cp.vdate != d.settle_date) THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0) * -1 WHEN (instr('C6', d.ps) > 0 and cp.vdate != d.settle_date) THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0) * -1 WHEN (instr('C5,T07', d.ps) > 0 and cp.vdate != d.settle_date) THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0) * -1 WHEN (instr('', d.ps) > 0 and cp.vdate != d.settle_date) THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0) * -1 WHEN cp.vdate = d.settle_date THEN 0 ELSE 0 END,0)) as shareLastDay from FIN_PRODUCT cp left join FIN_PRODUCT scp on scp.p_finprod_id = cp.finprod_id inner join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL d on cp.finprod_id = d.finprod_id or scp.finprod_id = d.finprod_id where cp.finprod_id = #{finprodId} and d.SETTLE_DATE <= (STR_TO_DATE(#{settleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')-1)

select sum(IFNULL(d.INT_AMT,0)) as intAmt from fin_product cp left join FIN_PRODUCT scp on scp.p_finprod_id = cp.finprod_id inner join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL d on cp.finprod_id = d.finprod_id where cp.finprod_id = #{finprodId} and d.SETTLE_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{settleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')

select SUM(IFNULL(CASE WHEN (instr('C1,T18', d.ps) > 0 ) THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0) WHEN (instr('C3', d.ps) > 0 ) THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0)
WHEN (instr('C2,C10,T04,T05', d.ps) > 0 ) THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0) WHEN (instr('C4,T06,T19,T24', d.ps) > 0 and cp.vdate != d.settle_date) THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0) * -1 WHEN (instr('C6', d.ps) > 0 ) THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0) * -1 WHEN (instr('C5,T07', d.ps) > 0 ) THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0) * -1 WHEN (instr('', d.ps) > 0 ) THEN IFNULL(d.share_amt, 0) * -1 ELSE 0 END,0)) as shareRemainderDay from FIN_PRODUCT cp left join FIN_PRODUCT scp on scp.p_finprod_id = cp.finprod_id inner join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL d on cp.finprod_id = d.finprod_id or scp.finprod_id = d.finprod_id where cp.finprod_id = #{finprodId} and d.SETTLE_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{settleDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
and d.finprod_type in ('F16','F18','F22','F26')

select * from ( SELECT A.FINPROD_ID AS code, A.FINPROD_NAME AS name, A.FINPROD_ID AS hidCode, A.FINPROD_ABBR AS shortName, A.PROFIT_TYPE as profitType FROM FIN_PRODUCT A WHERE A.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F16'
union all select ACCT_SUBJECT_ID AS code, BOOKSET_NAME_SON AS name, ACCT_SUBJECT_ID AS hidCode, BOOKSET_NAME_SON AS shortName, '03' as profitType from bok_bookset_re where ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = 'F26' ) a where 1=1
AND a.profitType IN
#{item}
AND ( a.code like concat_ws('','%',#{param},'%') OR a.name like concat_ws('','%',#{param},'%') )
